title: mithridatea toxicaria
intro: Mithridatea toxicaria, commonly known as the poison nut or poison tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat various gastrointestinal issues and its potential anti-inflammatory properties.
